description: This Java class defines configuration options for health checking actors, including settings for enabling health checks, check intervals, and persistence checks, with builder pattern support.

classes.name: HealthCheckingActorOptions
classes.description: Immutable configuration class for health checking actor options, including methods for comparison, string representation, and a nested builder class.

classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of HealthCheckingActorOptions with optional persistence check enabling.

methods.description: Returns whether the health check is enabled globally.

methods.name: isPersistenceCheckEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether persistence health check is enabled.
